summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests zimberelimab with stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT), with or without quemliclustat and etrumadenant, given before surgery in people with localized pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma who can have surgery. Zimberelimab is given intravenously every 2 weeks for 7 weeks (4 doses), quemliclustat is given intravenously on the same schedule in some groups, etrumadenant is taken by mouth daily for 7 weeks in one group, and SBRT is 40 Gy in 5 fractions. The study's stated goals are to check whether the treatment is safe and whether it further increases the immune response against the tumor.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa zimberelimab con radioterapia corporal estereotáxica (SBRT), con o sin quemliclustat y etrumadenant, administrados antes de la cirugía en personas con adenocarcinoma ductal de páncreas localizado que pueden someterse a cirugía. Zimberelimab se administra por vía intravenosa cada 2 semanas durante 7 semanas (4 dosis), quemliclustat se administra por vía intravenosa con el mismo esquema en algunos grupos, etrumadenant se toma por vía oral a diario durante 7 semanas en un grupo, y la SBRT es de 40 Gy en 5 fracciones. Los objetivos indicados por el estudio son verificar si el tratamiento es seguro y si aumenta aún más la respuesta inmunitaria contra el tumor.
who_for: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma confirmed by pathology
Completed 8 cycles of neoadjuvant modified FOLFIRINOX
Surgically resectable disease and considered appropriate for the operation
not_for: Prior treatment with immune checkpoint blockers such as anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1 or anti-CTLA-4 antibodies
Receiving other investigational agents or other anticancer drugs at the same time (hormone therapy allowed)
Active or past autoimmune disease or immune deficiency
Past or current idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis
Positive HIV test, active hepatitis B or C, or clinically significant liver disease
